name: Plesiosaur Skeleton in Polychrome Chalk Matrix (Paleo Prep Study)
category: Educational Asset - Paleontological Preparation / Geology Study
description: A top-down photograph of a meticulously prepared plesiosaur skeleton embedded within a continuous block of natural chalk that acts as a physical color gradient. The image showcases the range of colors natural chalk can exhibit due to mineral impurities, ranging from pale gray-whites to rich terracotta and ochre.

color_palette.foreground_fossil: dark charcoal grey to deep amber-brown (fossil bone)

matrix_dominant.left: cool pale grey and soft purple-blue
matrix_dominant.center: cream-white with warm peach and pale yellow washes
matrix_dominant.right: intense rusty terracotta and warm ochre

color_palette.background_lab: muted greys, brushed metal, clear glass

key_elements.description: A detailed, articulated skeleton of a small plesiosaur (head, neck, ribcage, four paddles) oriented horizontally.
key_elements.state: Partially exposed, dark petrified bone contrasting sharply with matrix.

key_elements.description: A single, large, rectangular block of natural chalk with a smooth, matte surface, serving as the canvas for the skeleton and color study.
key_elements.gradient_description: The block's surface is smooth and features blending zones. From left (cool), through center (warm cream/peach), to right (intense rusty red and deep gray).

key_elements.description: A hand wearing a white glove, positioned at the bottom right, carefully manipulating a micro air-scribe.
key_elements.action: Applying localized task light and tool tip to the rusty terracotta zone of the matrix, creating small piles of colored chalk dust.

key_elements.description: Micro air-scribe with hose, various brushes, and picks visible in the lab background.
Background setting with shelves holding glass vials, tools, and a microscope (left) and a plaster field jacketed fossil (right).
Overhead diffuse lamp and a focused, intense task light highlighting the specific area of preparation.
